in_sanskrit.name: जयावती

in_tamil.name: ஜயவாதி
in_tamil.long_meaning: விஜயத்தினால் வாழ்வியம் (Vijayattināl vāzhviyam) - She who is the embodiment of victory

in_marathi.name: Jayavathi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayavathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jayavathi is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jaya', which means victory, and 'Vathi', which means goddess. The name is often associated with the goddess Durga and signifies the triumph of good over evil.
